name: stat-strip
title: Stat strip
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A dense row or a divided panel of labelled numbers, each with a text delta. Distinct from metric-card and stats-band.

meta.descriptionEs: Una fila densa o un panel dividido de números, cada uno con su cambio en texto.

examples.title: Franja de cifras
examples.description: Fila y panel, es-MX y en-US.

api.name: items
api.description: Label, value, format, delta, and caption.

api.name: variant
api.description: A wrapping row, or equal columns with dividers.

api.name: variant="tiles"
api.description: tiles lays the stats out as cards. featured inverts one tile.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
